meta.name: onboarding
meta.description: Guides a first-time omo user through setup and the core workflow. Use when a new user asks to get started with omo.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 跟着引导完成首次配置,顺畅跑通核心工作流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚接触这个工具,想快速知道从哪一步开始。
copy.tagline_en: Walk through first-time setup and get the core workflow running
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're new to this tool and unsure where to begin.

howto.what: 首次使用 omo 时,它带你依次走完功能导览、迁移旧配置、翻查历史会话、估算缓存节省、记录长期记忆等六个环节,并给出基于你本地日志的量化估算。
howto.when: 当新用户表示想上手 omo 时接管,进行第一次引导对话;该引导只自动启动一次,之后需用 `omo --onboard` 等命令手动唤回。

say.text: 我想开始用 omo,带我走一遍。
say.note: 依次进入六个环节的引导。

say.text: 我原来用的是 Claude Code,帮我把配置迁过来。
say.note: 抓取已有配置,先给方案并等你确认。

say.text: 看看我以前那些会话,算算开缓存能省多少。
say.note: 需先同意读取历史会话才有数据。

howto.what_en: On a first omo run it walks a new user through six lanes: a feature tour, migration of an existing agent setup, past-session archaeology, cache-savings estimates, ongoing memory recording, and an init-deep proposal.
howto.when_en: It takes over when a new user asks to get started with omo; the guided first conversation auto-starts only once, and afterwards can be brought back with omo --onboard.

say_en.text: I want to get started with omo — walk me through it.
I came from Claude Code; carry my setup over.
say_en.note: Scrapes existing config, shows a plan, waits for your yes.

say_en.text: Look at my old sessions and estimate what caching would have saved.
say_en.note: Needs your OK to read past sessions first.
